STATE OF CALIFORNIA — HEALTH AND HUMAN SERVICES AGENCY
CALIFORNIA DEPARTMENT OF SOCIAL SERVICES

Date: May 27, 2026
Case Name: HERNANDEZ, NICOLAS
Case Number: XXXXXXX55

OPPOSITION TO PROPOSED DISMISSAL

TO THE ADMINISTRATIVE LAW JUDGE:

I, Nicolas Hernandez, hereby submit this formal opposition to the Proposed Dismissal issued in the above-referenced case. The proposed dismissal is based on the erroneous assumption that the issues raised in my request for a State Hearing have been resolved or are otherwise moot. This is not the case.

L.A. Care Health Plan has consistently failed to provide accurate information regarding the location and availability of its providers. Specifically, the 'ghost' office at 1055 W. 7th St. remains listed in provider directories despite the facility being closed to the public for health services since 2024. This discrepancy is not a mere clerical error but a systemic failure that prevents access to medically necessary care.

Furthermore, the plan's resolution of my internal grievance (Case No. XXXXXXXX) was defective, as it failed to address the core issue of transportation and appointment scheduling failures. Dismissing this hearing would allow L.A. Care to continue its pattern of 'weaponized bureaucracy' without oversight.

I request that the hearing be stayed or proceeded with to address the merits of the plan's failure to comply with Knox-Keene Act requirements and Medi-Cal managed care regulations.

Respectfully submitted,

[Signature]

Nicolas Hernandez
Complainant
